{{Short description|Soviet and Russian mathematician}}
[[File:Yuri V. Nesterenko.jpeg|thumb|200px|Nesterenko at the workshop "Diophantic Approximations" in [[Mathematical Research Institute of Oberwolfach|Oberwolfach]], 2007]]

'''Yuri Valentinovich Nesterenko''' ({{langx|ru|link=no|Ю́рий Валенти́нович Нестере́нко}}; born 5 December 1946 in [[Kharkov]], [[USSR]], now [[Ukraine]]) is a Soviet and Russian mathematician who has written papers in [[algebraic independence]] theory and [[transcendental number theory]].

In 1997, he was awarded the [[Ostrowski Prize]] for his proof that the numbers <math>\pi</math> and <math>e^\pi</math> are [[algebraic independence|algebraically independent]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Nesterenko |first=Yu V |date=31 October 1996 |title=Modular functions and transcendence questions |url=https://doi.org/10.1070/SM1996v187n09ABEH000158 |journal=[[Matematicheskii Sbornik]] |volume=187 |issue=9 |pages=1319–1348 |doi=10.1070/sm1996v187n09abeh000158 |issn=1064-5616|url-access=subscription }}</ref> In fact, he proved the stronger result:
* the numbers <math>\pi, e^\pi</math>, and [[Gamma function|<math>\Gamma</math>]]<math>(1/4)</math> are algebraically independent over <math>\mathbb{Q}.</math>
* the numbers <math>\pi, e^{\pi\sqrt{3}}</math>, and <math>\Gamma(1/3)</math> are algebraically independent over <math>\mathbb{Q}.</math>
* for all positive integers ''n'', the numbers <math>\pi</math> and <math>e^{\pi\sqrt{n}}</math> are algebraically independent over <math>\mathbb{Q}.</math>

Nesterenko is a professor at [[Lomonosov Moscow State University|Moscow State University]], where he completed the mechanical-mathematical program in 1969, then the doctorate program (Soviet habilitation) in 1973, and became a professor of the Number Theory Department in 1992.

He studied under [[E-function#The Siegel–Shidlovsky theorem|Andrei Borisovich Shidlovskii]]. Nesterenko's students have included [[Wadim Zudilin]].
